Andrew asks Audrey how she got her dog, to which Audrey responds with gratitude, mentioning her luck in finding a nearby breeder that has dogs and the difficulty of finding places that allow dogs. Andrew agrees that it is tough to find suitable parks, noting that he has found parks where he can take a puppy on a leash, but it is not the same as having an open area for the dog to run and play. Andrew promises to let Audrey know if he finds something. Audrey suggests joining Andrew for a hike with their dogs, emphasizing the joy of having a chance for the dogs to run freely. Andrew enthusiastically agrees to the hike, stating he is down for it next month when the weather is pleasant, and mentions a great trail for dogs. Audrey expresses her excitement about the hike, hoping to find a spot with a great view and room for exploration, anticipating a blast. Andrew looks forward to seeing the dogs and having fun hiking, mentioning that he will map out the trail. Audrey confirms she will look into a trail for her furry friend to run. Andrew agrees that it sounds good and emphasizes the importance of making the trail safe for dogs to run and have fun. Audrey reiterates that safety is the top priority when dogs are outside running. Andrew agrees, stating that it is great to be with dogs. Audrey then mentions that there is cool stuff happening today, sharing an image of three dogs sitting on the floor with leashes.

episodic_summary: As of 16 August, 2023, Audrey shares that each of her pets has a favorite spot to relax, mentioning that Pepper loves the couch, Pixie curls up in bed, Precious has a chair, and Panda lies on a rug, indicating that all of her pets have their own cozy spots. Andrew responds enthusiastically, stating that it sounds adorable and notes that pets finding little spots brings joy and comfort, mentioning that Toby is at his favorite spot. Andrew shares an image of a dog laying on a fluffy blanket on the floor. Audrey agrees, saying that pets know how to get comfy and mentions a picture of her pets snuggling on their favorite blanket, sharing an image of two dogs laying on a blanket on a couch. Andrew finds them adorable and asks if they always sleep like that. Audrey confirms that they always sleep cuddled together, especially at nap time, and emphasizes that they are best friends.

episodic_summary: As of 3 July, 2023, Andrew expresses his recent enjoyment in finding new hobbies, specifically mentioning that he has been getting into cooking and trying new recipes, which he finds enjoyable. Andrew asks Audrey if she enjoys cooking and what her favorite recipes are. Audrey enthusiastically responds that she loves cooking, sharing that her favorite recipe is Chicken Pot Pie, which she describes as cozy and delicious, especially on a cold day. Audrey offers to share the recipe with Andrew, showing an image of a pie on a wooden board with a knife. Andrew responds positively, commenting on the pie's appearance and asking what inspired Audrey to make it. Audrey agrees to send the recipe shortly, explaining that it is a family recipe that has been around for years, and the flavors remind her of her grandmother's kitchen, evoking memories of conversations at the table. She expresses hope that Andrew will like it and inquires about his cooking progress, showing another image of a pie with a lattice on top. Andrew thanks Audrey and shares that cooking is helping him de-stress and be creative, although he admits he is still a rookie but is having fun experimenting. He asks Audrey what she enjoys about cooking. Audrey replies that she loves trying new recipes and experimenting in the kitchen, describing it as an escape that is great for de-stressing and allowing her creativity to flow. Andrew agrees, stating that cooking provides an escape and allows him to try something new, with the added bonus of enjoying food afterward. He mentions that cooking is slowly becoming one of his favorite hobbies, as it is relaxing and allows him to express his creativity. Audrey concurs, stating that cooking and eating food is rewarding and likens it to a form of self-care. She shares that she enjoys putting on music, pouring a glass of wine, and going with the flow in the kitchen, describing it as therapeutic. She shows Andrew an image of a plate of food with a lot of vegetables, which Andrew admires, asking if cooking is calming and what her go-to ingredient is in the kitchen. Audrey responds that cooking is calming for her and that garlic is her go-to ingredient, as she loves the smell and taste it adds to dishes. Andrew agrees that garlic is delicious and asks if she has a favorite dish to make with it, requesting a recipe if so. Audrey confirms that Roasted Chicken is one of her favorites and promises to send the recipe shortly, showing a photograph of a pan of chicken and potatoes on a stove. Andrew expresses excitement about making it, commenting on how amazing it looks and asking what inspired Audrey. Audrey shares that the recipe is based on Mediterranean flavors, describing it as a tasty dish that is easy to make and loaded with healthy ingredients like chicken, garlic, lemon, and herbs, calling it her favorite comfort meal. Andrew responds with enthusiasm, stating that it sounds delicious and healthy, and mentions that he is always looking for new meal ideas, especially healthier ones. He appreciates Audrey for sharing the recipe and thanks her. Audrey reassures Andrew that it is no problem and hopes he enjoys making and eating the dish, asking him to let her know how it turns out.

episodic_summary: As of 27 July, 2023, Andrew greets Audrey and shares that he and his girlfriend had a great experience volunteering at a pet shelter on 24 July, 2023. Andrew expresses that spending time with cute animals brought him joy and reminded him of his love for them. Audrey responds positively, stating that she is good and finds volunteering at a pet shelter to be awesome, emphasizing the happiness of the animals and encouraging Andrew to volunteer again someday. Andrew thanks Audrey and reflects on how seeing the animals content makes him happy, asking if Audrey has ever volunteered at an animal shelter, which he finds rewarding. Audrey admits she has never been to an animal shelter but believes it must be great. She shares a picture of herself kissing one of her four fur babies in a park, saying that they are more important to her. Andrew finds the photo cute and asks Audrey to tell him more about the personalities of her pets. Audrey describes her oldest pet as the most relaxed, like a wise old sage, the second as ready for a game, the third as naughty and loving cuddles, and the youngest as full of life and always up for adventure. Andrew expresses amazement at her pets and mentions that they remind him of his childhood dog, sharing a photo of a dog sitting on the floor with a tennis ball, which he describes as the most playful one ever. Audrey identifies the dog in the photo as Max, her childhood dog, who had a lot of energy and loved playing fetch, creating great memories for her. Andrew agrees, stating that pets' love and energy brighten their days and create amazing memories. He asks Audrey if she remembers any other special memories with Max, to which she responds that she and Max took long walks in the neighborhood, exploring new paths while he sniffed and marked his territory. Audrey fondly recalls sharing her worries and hopes with Max, who was a great listener and always there for her, making those days her favorite memories. Andrew concludes that pets become friends and confidantes, providing comfort and understanding, and leaving a lasting mark on their lives. Audrey agrees, stating that pets make their lives better by listening without judgment and giving unconditional love, reminding them how it feels to be seen and understood. She expresses gratitude for having pets that bring joy, comfort, and love. Andrew affirms that this is why he and his girlfriend went volunteering with animals, describing it as one of the most rewarding things they have done, as animals lift their spirits with love, joy, and comfort. Audrey expresses her happiness for Andrew's experience, noting that animals brighten their days and give love and joy, and she is sure the pet shelter appreciated their help. Andrew concludes that they had a blast volunteering and giving back to make lives better, to which Audrey agrees, stating that Andrew's kindness and care surely made the animals happier.
